# MP3 MIDI Tool

> Browser-based audio and MIDI conversion tools with public guides.

## Core pages

- [MP3 to MIDI](https://mp3miditool.com/): Convert MP3, M4A, or FLAC in the visitor's browser.
- [WAV to MIDI](https://mp3miditool.com/wav-to-midi/): Convert WAV, MP3, M4A, or FLAC in the visitor's browser.
- [Audio to Sheet Music](https://mp3miditool.com/audio-to-sheet-music/): Render detected notes as downloadable notation.
- [MIDI to Sheet Music](https://mp3miditool.com/midi-to-sheet-music/): Render a MIDI file as notation.
- [MIDI to MP3](https://mp3miditool.com/midi-to-mp3/): Render MIDI to MP3 or WAV locally.

## Agent access

Read the [agent guide](https://mp3miditool.com/ai/) or use the bounded [public lookup API](https://mp3miditool.com/api/agent?task=list_pages). Files selected for conversion are not uploaded to the server.
